final: WITH equipment_averages AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(articount) AS avg_artifacts FROM scanfeatures GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_artifacts) AS overall_avg FROM equipment_averages), kept AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_artifacts, e.avg_artifacts - o.overall_avg AS difference FROM equipment_averages AS e CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND e.avg_artifacts > o.overall_avg), final_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_artifacts) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.equipref, k.avg_artifacts, k.difference, k.avg_artifacts / f.kept_avg AS ratio FROM kept AS k CROSS JOIN final_average AS f WHERE f.kept_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC LIMIT 10
